3.3 Supplements 
LEARNING OUTCOMES 
By the end of this section, you should be able to: 
• 3.3.1 Describe vitamin and mineral supplements’ role in nutrition and wellness. 
• 3.3.2 Evaluate vitamin and mineral supplements as part of a nutritional plan, including the potential for 
interactions. 
• 3.3.3 Examine special considerations for the nutritional needs associated with vulnerable populations 
and across the lifespan. 
Regulations and Recommendations for the Use of Supplements 
Eating a diet with fresh and minimally processed foods is the best source of vitamins and minerals. However, even 
people with healthy eating habits sometimes need help to bridge occasional nutrient gaps, and supplements may 
help.
